periods.label: 隐藏观战的色彩魔法使

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: observes the final hidden by Color Magic

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent and model of interest; she congratulates him after the final.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Companion she helps conceal near the venue.
relationships.edelweiss: Acquaintance who arrives to watch the final.

periods.summary: Sara uses Color Magic to hide herself, Rinna, Charlotte and Tsukikage at a cafe near the venue. She notices Edelweiss approaching and later watches the final, sketching the duel until she asks Edelweiss about the meaning of Ikki and Stella no longer matching. After Ikki wins, she quietly congratulates him.

key_events.summary: Conceals the group and identifies Edelweiss's arrival.
Reacts from the Akatsuki side after Ikki's victory.
